title: Two more ways to make images
summary:
Three community projects joined the directory, while ad translation learned to read more than the last message.

The project directory now lists CitizenOneX’s voice-prompted image app for the Frame wearable and @altkriz’s Imagen web interface, which uses the flux and turbo models. Both are community projects, not newly added Pollinations features.

The SDK and Libraries lists now include @voodoohop’s MCPollinations, which lets AI assistants use Pollinations image, text, and audio APIs. This change adds the listing, not the server.

Affiliate ad translation now checks the full content to identify its language, helping preserve original English wording when translation is unnecessary. The affiliate list also gained DreamGF for companion and chat topics.
